text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, this is the end of the latest 
volume."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... That was another turbulent 
development! Even through all that, the 
Saintess's conviction never wavered. I 
wonder what kind of heroic deeds she'll do 
next!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I should read it over once more— But I've 
been staying up late reading so much 
lately... I'll hold back and go to sleep 
tonight."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(...That foreshadowing will definitely be 
resolved in the next chapter. When that 
happens, what will become of the 
relationship between the Saint and the 
Knight...!)

In the end, Red Desire wound up staying up 
late this night as well...
